com.ecom.admin.release_notes: Each app now accepts only the accounts that belong to it. If your account cannot use this app, the screen tells you which app to open instead. The app info screen also shows the correct app name.

com.ecom.order.release_notes:
Wage Statement has been redesigned for readability and print quality:

- Much larger fonts throughout the statement. The time table now splits each day into a main row and a detail line instead of squeezing nine columns together.
- Earnings and deductions are now separate tables, each using the full width.
- The NET PAY box no longer prints a solid dark background - it uses a bold outline instead, which saves a significant amount of toner on every printed statement.
- Meal charges show count x unit price, and daily misc pay is listed per day, so totals can be verified.
- Page margins were re-tuned so the statement reliably fits on a single Letter page.
- Employee and employer signature lines are now aligned at the same height.

IMPORTANT - please delete the existing app before installing. This release is signed with a new security key, so Android will refuse to update over an older build. Your data is safe on the server; you only need to sign in again.

- Larger fonts throughout the statement (table text is now noticeably bigger and easier to read).
